import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
tab = np.loadtxt("data/pilot.csv", delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
X, y = (tab[:, :-1], tab[:, -1])
n, p = X.shape
F, _ = f_classif(X, y)

# correlation structure among top-30 F features
order = np.argsort(-F)[:30]
Xs = X[:, order]
Xz = (Xs - Xs.mean(0)) / Xs.std(0)
C = np.abs(np.corrcoef(Xz.T))
print("near-duplicate pairs (|r|>0.98) among top-30 F:")
for i in range(len(order)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(order)):
        if C[i, j] > 0.98:
            print(f"  x{order[i]+1} ~ x{order[j]+1}  r={C[i,j]:.4f}")
# count absolute correlations > 0.6 per feature (signal groupings)
print("\nmax |corr| to others among top-30:", " ".join(f"x{order[i]+1}:{C[i].max()-C[i,i]:.2f}" for i in range(12)))

# candidate screens
def stab_screen(X, y, thr, B=200, seed=0, K=30, cap=50):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    counts = np.zeros(X.shape[1])
    for b in range(B):
        idx = r.choice(len(y), size=len(y) // 2, replace=False)
        Fb, _ = f_classif(X[idx], y[idx])
        counts[np.argsort(-Fb)[:K]] += 1
    feats = np.where(counts / B >= thr)[0]
    if len(feats) > cap:
        feats = feats[np.argsort(-F[feats])[:cap]]
    return feats

for thr in (0.5, 0.3):
    f = stab_screen(X, y, thr)
    print(f"\nstab thr={thr}: {len(f)} features:", [f"x{i+1}" for i in f])
